# Parsera

Parsera provides AI-powered web extraction, content parsing, and reusable scraper agents through its developer API.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/parsera/.

## Actions

- **Extract Markdown** (read-only): Extract markdown content from a file or url.
- **Parse Content with Parsera** (read-only): Parse and extract structured data from provided html or text.
